sources.title: 百年京张AI创新带城市设计国际方案征集资格预审公告
sources.publisher: 北京市规划和自然资源委员会海淀分局
sources.usage: Official textual scope, approximate areas and task context.
sources.limitations: Professional qualification route is distinct from this GitHub Agent open call; no public precise polygon is supplied here.

sources.title: Agent open-call taskbook extract
sources.usage: Six Agent tasks, open-call principles, branding, operations and boundary clause.
sources.limitations: Structured extract, not a substitute for official planning attachments.

sources.title: Formal professional standards registry
sources.usage: Maps formal design decisions to named official standards.
sources.limitations: Local snapshots are navigation evidence; current official sources control.

sources.title: 中华人民共和国个人信息保护法
sources.publisher: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会 / 中国人大网
sources.usage: Articles 5, 6, 16, 19, 24, 26, 28-31, 34, 47, 50-56 and 59 support purpose limitation, minimum scope, shortest retention, sensitive-data safeguards and rights mechanisms.
sources.limitations: The law does not create M0-M3 levels or decide which exact Jing-Zhang transaction requires identity.

sources.title: 个人信息保护合规审计管理办法及审计指引
sources.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室
sources.usage: Field lists, shortest retention, recipients, automated-decision review and complaint mechanisms inform the ledger.
sources.limitations: Audit guidance is not a site approval or a substitute for matter-specific legal review.

sources.title: 人脸识别技术应用安全管理办法
sources.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室、公安部
sources.usage: Article 10 supports a reasonable and convenient non-face alternative where the same purpose can be met; other articles support necessity and impact assessment.
sources.limitations: Does not mean all face recognition is unlawful; applicability remains matter-specific.

sources.title: 国家网络身份认证公共服务管理办法
sources.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室等
sources.usage: Articles 6-9 support retained lawful alternatives, equal service for non-users, result-only verification and minimum data.
sources.limitations: A network identity is non-plaintext verified identity, not anonymity; no Jing-Zhang deployment is evidenced.

sources.title: 北京市无障碍环境建设条例
sources.publisher: 北京市人民代表大会常务委员会
sources.usage: Article 29 supports retaining and improving traditional service while introducing smart innovation; Articles 10 and 20-22 support user trials and accessible information.
sources.limitations: Does not prove a specific Jing-Zhang facility, route or staffed service exists.

sources.title: 北京市加快推动场景培育和开放应用工作方案
sources.usage: Supports bounded public-service scene cultivation and annual opening of scene resources/needs.
sources.limitations: Policy task is not permission for a particular Jing-Zhang location or technology.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-63-4 Digital Identity Guidelines
sources.publisher: US National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.usage: Supports asking whether real-world identity is needed before selecting assurance, and separating identity, authentication and federation assurance.
sources.limitations: US federal technical guidance is not Chinese law; IAL1 is not an anonymous tier.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 on the European Digital Identity Framework
sources.usage: Selective disclosure, pseudonyms, voluntary use and retained alternatives inform attribute-only proof.
sources.limitations: EU law is not a Chinese compliance basis; the wallet is high-assurance identity, not anonymous service.

sources.title: Login.gov identity verification and alternative channels
sources.usage: Separates account, identity proofing and agency eligibility; documents mail/in-person recovery for some agencies.
sources.limitations: Coverage is partial and still has email, phone and document barriers; not a full offline model.

sources.title: RealMe verified identity and privacy documentation
sources.publisher: New Zealand Department of Internal Affairs
sources.usage: Separates ordinary login and verified identity, per-service identifiers and alternative verification.
sources.limitations: RealMe remains identified and retains some verification records for long statutory periods that must not be copied.

sources.title: Algorithms and AI in Amsterdam
sources.usage: Public purpose, responsibility, human contact, complaint and procurement/audit tools inform the threshold card.
sources.limitations: A register does not prove an algorithm is fair or directly transplant Dutch administrative rights.

sources.title: Testbed Helsinki smart mobility
sources.usage: Bounded place/time, operator presence, stop conditions and post-test evaluation inform three validation scenarios.
sources.limitations: A pilot does not prove safety, legality, value or scalability in Beijing.

sources.title: AccessMap and OpenSidewalks
sources.publisher: University of Washington CREATE / Taskar Center
sources.usage: AI extraction plus human verification and explicit uncertainty inform accessibility data governance.
sources.limitations: Database coverage does not prove real-time physical accessibility or Jing-Zhang conditions.

sources.title: Noto Sans CJK / Noto Sans SC
sources.usage: Local system copy is subset-embedded in generated PDF and used to rasterize original diagrams.
sources.limitations: Raw font file is not redistributed; use follows the SIL Open Font License.
